query: What is the standard return window and restocking fee in our refund policy?
expected_output: Customers may return eligible hardware within 30 days of delivery. Opened non-defective items may be subject to a 15% restocking fee, while defective items under warranty qualify for a full refund.
retrieval_context: Standard Return Window: 30 calendar days from delivery date. Defective hardware within warranty receives a 100% full refund with no restocking fee. Non-defective opened hardware incurs a 15% restocking fee.

query: What is the uptime SLA for the Enterprise Cloud Suite?
expected_output: The Enterprise Cloud Suite Annual License includes a 99.95% uptime SLA.
retrieval_context: Enterprise Cloud Suite Annual License: Full SaaS subscription with 99.95% uptime SLA and 24/7 priority support.
